variant.title: CV on (P5A auto_enhance)
variant.hypothesis: Dead-banded enhancement leaves most images untouched; effect on CLIP is small. Untuned thresholds: may help or hurt.

protocol.latency_definition: generation_ms = wall time of engine.generate() (text encode + denoise + VAE decode + CUDA sync). cv_ms = wall time of the CV pipeline on that image (0 when CV is off; counted even when the pipeline bypasses). end_to_end_ms = generation_ms + cv_ms. Excludes model load, PNG save, CLIP scoring. Model load is reported separately (model_load_ms). Encode/denoise/decode split is recorded only if the engine result exposes `stage_ms`; otherwise null.
protocol.memory_definition: peak_gpu_mb = per-generation torch.cuda peak allocated reported by the engine; peak_reserved_mb = torch.cuda peak reserved over the whole timed phase (after reset post warm-up); peak_process_ram_mb = peak working set / max RSS of THIS process since start (includes model load; system RAM, never mixed with VRAM)
